properties.name: A proof says what it assumes, and an agent asks: phase 2 of the primes-trial fixes
properties.rationale:
From fact:the-primes-trial-rung-1-ran-on-flo2-io-and-its-friction-names-what-counts-2026-10-17, friction items 5-8, for req:a-proof-can-discharge-an-assumption-and-generalize-over-a-variable, req:an-agent-asks-the-owner-its-own-question-about-a-node and the parts of req:a-proof-is-designed-with-a-skill-and-the-tools-fit-mathematics phase 1 left. Anthony's choices followed: assumptions as a PREMISE ROLE, variables DECLARED AND CHECKED. Choices made where the brief left one: (1) the role is an edge enum (`role`, no default: absent reads premise) and the discharge a `list:string` on the discharging step, so no edge or node type is added; (2) "fixes" means a record lists the variable in `fixes` (`name=value` or a bare name), checked at any depth beneath the step, assumed premises included; a violation makes the step's verdict unknown, so its conclusion is unsupported, never refuted; the same name is the same variable (structural, not a logic); (3) an assumed premise holds inside the argument whatever its own truth, and is never walked by the what-if; a claim holding only under an undischarged assumption reads a new proof_status `conditional` rather than shown; (4) statement kind is a new field `statement_kind` on Requirement and Constraint, not new values of Requirement.kind, whose software values keep their meaning; definition/axiom imply taken as given unless taken_as_given says false; a conjecture's `refuted` is computed (an objection that holds), not a status anybody sets; the five kinds are exactly the ones Anthony named; (5) independence is stated on the second line's step (`independent_of`, `independent_except`) and checked over steps: the lines may share no step outside the named lemmas' own derivations; definitions share no step so never count; a false statement changes no truth and is a `reasoning_not_as_stated` gap; (6) one new gap source for all three not-as-stated cases, per occurrence, severity 0.5; the unconfirmed_reasoning gap is unchanged; (7) ask_question requires `asked_of` and `about`, derives the id from the wording, keeps the wording immutable, and Question.gap_id became optional rather than carrying a sentinel; (8) Constraint.direction lost its schema default and add_constraint writes `maximum` only beside a `limit`, so stored constraints and budgets round-trip unchanged. MEASURED with the published v0.85.0 binary on a store this build wrote: it opens it with no warning and re-stamps it, drops the new stamp keys, misreads Euclid's reductio as unproven (it ignores the role), keeps every property, and refuses to import an export holding an ask_question question (gap_id missing); a release would also refuse it by version without accept_newer. Tests: 9 core and 6 MCP, all observed failing on main's source first. Checks run locally: cargo dev-test (both crates), both clippy -D warnings, fmt, validate_schema, discrimination rules, skill_lint and its test, command surface, render_skills_and_tools, toolsnap, smoke, empty_speaks, refusal_speaks, titles, tool_confusability, replies_are_bounded, a_reply_is_sent_once, vocabulary_reach and its test, PII, changelog fragments, check_doc_versions, test_site_counts, test_init, phase_trial, model_the_loop, coherent_erosion_trial, stateless_seat_probe, test_call_door, lessons at the step.

Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Phase 2 of the primes-trial fixes Anthony accepted on 2026-10-17. Discharged assumptions as a premise role: PREMISE_OF `role: assumed` (add_inference `assumed`) and `Inference.discharges` (refused unless assumed beneath); a discharged assumption is gone from truth, foundations and the what-if; an undischarged one makes its claims `conditional` (new proof_status) and is a `reasoning_not_as_stated` gap; reasoning_report reads "assumed, discharged by …". Declared, checked variables: `Inference.generalizes_over`, and `variables` / `fixes` on Requirement, Constraint and Verification; a step generalizing over a variable anything beneath it fixes reads unknown with the reason. `statement_kind` (theorem, lemma, definition, axiom, conjecture) read as `statement_reading` (a conjecture open, then refuted). `independent_of` / `independent_except` on a step, checked. `ask_question`: an agent's own question to a named Contributor, no gap behind it (Question.gap_id now optional; open_questions rows carry `origin`). Constraint.direction loses its schema default (add_constraint writes `maximum` beside a limit). The served design-a-proof skill.
